title: Normalized lax tensor pairing for ringed direct image
statement: Let $(C,J),(D,K)$ be sites small relative to a fixed coefficient universe [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let $v:C\to D$ induce direct image of sheaves by precomposition, let $R,S$ be commutative ring sheaves on $C,D$, and let $c:R\to v_*S$ be a unital ring-sheaf map. For $S$-module sheaves put $(PM)(U)=M(vU)$ with $R(U)$ acting through $c_U$, and let $P$ act on maps by precomposition [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Use sheafified balanced tensors [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and regular modules as units, with their canonical associators and unitors [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed]. There is a unique lax monoidal structure on $P$ whose tensor map sends every local pure tensor $x\otimes y$ over $U$ to the local pure tensor $x\otimes y$ over $vU$. Here lax monoidal means natural maps $\mu_{M,N}:PM\otimes_RPN\to P(M\otimes_SN)$ and $e:R\to PS$ satisfying the associativity and both unit coherence identities. Its unit satisfies $e_U(r)=c_U(r)$ for every $U,r$.
